# WeTeK
Artec is an educative program offered by WeTeK Berlin gGmbH.

## Modules
Artec courses are built from modules that cover various topics such as:
- 2D Game Design
- 3D Design und Druck
- Foto und Film Bearbeitung / Erstellung
- Medientechnologie
- TypeScript Einleitung
- Prompt Engineering

These modules target students (after high school) and staff (freelance or unemployed) who are interested in art, media, and systems.
